summary.text: Brett Geymann is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 35, representing Beauregard and Calcasieu, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2003 and 2021 as the years elected.
The page lists Brett Geymann with committee assignments including Natural Resources and Environment (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Brett Geymann's occupation as Owner, Patriot Construction and Development; Co-Owner/President, Outfitter Ink.
It lists Brett Geymann's education as South Beauregard High School; B.S., Finance, McNeese State University.
The House member page lists Brett Geymann's committee assignments as Natural Resources and Environment (Chair); House Select Committee on Homeland Security.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
